The shared one-hour deadline elapsed while the first developer child was still active. Tester and UI reviews never started; the requested specialist workflow did not complete.
Source uses state-waiting while the red waiting CSS selector is state-ready; the intended waiting color rule does not match the DOM state.

At the 30-minute checkpoint the developer had made 71 tool calls, peak prompt 66,692 tokens, and 64,472 reported output tokens, with no other role started.
